payload.title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
payload.goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path

payload.text:
Finished the wiring the previous run left open.

decision: RateLimiter instance is shared via Deps from createDeps so per-tenant counts persist across requests.
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because loadConfig gained rateLimitMax/rateLimitWindowMs and the old assertions no longer matched the config shape.

What I did:
- Kept `src/config.ts` (`rateLimitMax` default 100, `rateLimitWindowMs` default 60000) and `src/lib/limiter.ts` fixed-window `RateLimiter` from the previous diff.
- Added `limiter: RateLimiter` to `Deps` in `src/app.ts` and construct it in `createDeps()`.
- Wired the check into `POST /webhooks` in `src/routes/webhooks.ts` using `deps.config.rateLimitMax` / `rateLimitWindowMs` (no constants in the route); over-limit returns 429 `{ error: 'rate limit exceeded' }` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds.
- Added `test/rate-limit.test.ts` covering: 429 + `Retry-After` on excess, other tenants unaffected, limit honored from config.
- Updated `test/config.test.ts` expectations to include the new config fields and env vars.
- Ran `bun run test` (30 passed) and `bun run typecheck` (clean) locally; daemon will re-run `bun run test` as the record.

What I did not finish:
- No sliding-window or distributed limiter; in-memory fixed window per process only.
- No dedicated unit tests for window expiry/`retryAfterSec` math edge cases in `RateLimiter`.

What I did not look at:
- The `review-voice-policy` skill (no `.review-voice/policy.yaml` work involved).
- `src/routes/admin.ts`, `events.ts`, `audit.ts`, and `src/lib/store.ts` beyond confirming the webhook route contract.
